 Match Preview
 UEFA Nations League C - Game Week 5 Nov 13, 2026 - 09:00 Zimbru Stadium Moldova host Kazakhstan at the Zimbru Stadium in Chisinau in a UEFA Nations League C fixture that carries real weight for both sides in the group standings.
 Lilian Popescu's Moldova side come into this match having won the reverse fixture in October, a 2-1 victory away in Kazakhstan that will give them confidence heading into this home tie. Their Nations League campaign has been mixed, with defeats to Slovakia bookending that win, but the Zimbru crowd will back them to build on that positive result.
 Kazakhstan, managed by John van't Schip, arrive having drawn their most recent outing 2-2 against the Faroe Islands. That result continued a run of inconsistency for a side that has struggled to string results together in this group.
 Moldova sit third in Group 3 while Kazakhstan occupy fourth place, meaning both teams are under pressure to pick up points and improve their standing before the group stage concludes.
